profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc is a Toronto-based public company, traded under the ticker CLS, that describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. Per its own site, it engineers, designs and manufactures what it calls the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and it says it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud and hybrid cloud while advancing technologies in high-growth markets. The company states that it serves customers through a global network and aims to help them achieve a competitive advantage.

The company's own material positions AI and cloud infrastructure as its central market rather than as a standalone product line. No specific AI products, lawsuits, or other tracked items are recorded for Celestica. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001030894 and headquarters in Toronto.
